canonical_name: full singular value decomposition for finite real or complex rectangular matrices
literal_source_claim_zh: 任意矩阵可分解为UΣV*形式
literal_source_claim_en: Every matrix can be decomposed in U Sigma V* form.
canonical_statement: Every finite rectangular real or complex matrix has a full singular value decomposition into square orthogonal or unitary left and right factors and a conforming rectangular diagonal factor with nonnegative real diagonal entries.
canonical_claim: For each finite m-by-n matrix A over R or C, there exist square orthogonal or unitary matrices U and V and an m-by-n rectangular diagonal matrix Sigma with nonnegative real diagonal entries such that A = U * Sigma * V*.
statement_blocker: The exact Lean target, conventions, transports, mutations, and empty-dimension witnesses are self-tested. Master statement acceptance is pending; independent admission/review of the Axler source, its nonzero-space and ordering boundary, and reconciliation of likely duplicate THM-M-1449 remain source-governance blockers and prevent H0, not elaboration of the explicitly frozen proposition.
